# 1. FLANKER
## Libraries
```{r}
install.packages("schoRsch")
install.packages("readxl")
install.packages("ez")
library(schoRsch)
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(readxl)
library(ez)
```

## Instructions - all commented
```{r}
# Instructions for data
# This spreadsheet contains the 2x2-AFC flanker data with SOA manipulation.  
# The first column includes participants' number.
# The second column is the trial number in the experiment. 
# The third column represents the orientation of the target arrow shown in a particular trial, where 1 for left, 2 for right, 3 for upward and 4 for downward. 
# The forth column shows the orientation of the flanker arrows in the same notion as the third column. 
# The fifth column reveals the RT of the trial in milliseconds. whether the trial is correct or not, where 1 is correct, and 0 means incorrect. 
# The sixth column shows whether the trial is correct or not, where 1 is correct, and 0 means incorrect.  the congreuncy condition of the trial, where 1 for congruent and 0 for incongruent.
# The seventh column shows the congreuncy condition of the trial, where 1 for congruent and 0 for incongruent. 
# The final column records the SOA levels, including -100, 0, 50, 100. Note hat the sign of the SOA in the this spreadsheet is opposite to what we define in the manuscript. 
```


## Reading data 

```{r}
rm(list = ls())
which_dat = "FlankerSOA-repl.xlsx"
data = readxl::read_excel(which_dat)
```

## pre_processing
```{r}
raw_data <- data %>% 
  mutate(prev_Congruency = dplyr::lag(data$Congruency), 
         prev_Accuracy = dplyr::lag(data$Accuracy))

processed_data = raw_data[raw_data$RT >= 200 & raw_data$RT <= 1500,]
processed_data = processed_data[!(processed_data$`Trial Number` %in% c(1, 121, 241, 361, 481, 601, 721, 841)),]
processed_data = processed_data[processed_data$Accuracy == 1 & processed_data$prev_Accuracy == 1,]
```

## ANOVA
```{r}
processed_data$Participant = as.factor(processed_data$Participant)
processed_data$Congruency = as.factor(processed_data$Congruency)
processed_data$prev_Congruency = as.factor(processed_data$prev_Congruency)
processed_data$SOA = as.factor(processed_data$SOA)

aov.rt = ezANOVA(processed_data,
                 dv = RT,
                 wid = Participant,
                 within = .(Congruency, prev_Congruency, SOA),
                 detailed = TRUE,
                 return_aov = TRUE)
anova_out(aov.rt)
```


## Post-hoc analyses
```{r}
library(broom)
k_data <- subset(processed_data, SOA == -50)
aov.k = ezANOVA(k_data,dv = RT,
                wid = Participant,
                within = .(prev_Congruency, Congruency),
                detailed = TRUE,
                return_aov = TRUE)
anova_out(aov.k)
```

## Mean error rates for experimental conditions
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
data = read_excel("FlankerSOA.xlsx")
names(data)[2] = "TrialNum"
```

## calculate variables
```{r}
data$n1Accuracy = lag(data$Accuracy, 1)
data$n1Congruency = lag(data$Congruency, 1)
data$n1ArrowNum = lag(data$ArrowNum, 1)
firsttrials = c(0:7)*120+1
```

## exclude trials
```{r}
fdata = data %>%
  filter(!(TrialNum%in%firsttrials), RT >= 200, RT <= 1500)

gdata <- data.frame(Congruency=fdata$Congruency, 
                    n1Congruency=fdata$n1Congruency,
                    SOA=fdata$SOA,
                    Accuracy=fdata$Accuracy)

gdata %>% group_by(Congruency,n1Congruency,SOA) %>% summarise (x = mean(Accuracy))
```

# 2. SPATIAL STROOP
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
which_dat = "spatialStroopSOA.xlsx"
data = readxl::read_excel(which_dat)
```

# pre_processing
```{r}
data$prev_Congruency = dplyr::lag(data$Congruency)
data$prev_Accuracy = dplyr::lag(data$Accuracy)
data = data[data$RT >= 200 & data$RT <= 1500,]
data = data[!(data$`Trial Number` %in% c(1, 121, 241, 361, 481, 601, 721, 841)),]
data = data[data$Accuracy == 1 & data$prev_Accuracy == 1,]
```


## ANOVA
```{r}
data$Participant = as.factor(data$Participant)
data$Congruency = as.factor(data$Congruency)
data$prev_Congruency = as.factor(data$prev_Congruency)
data$SOA = as.factor(data$SOA)

aov.rt = ezANOVA(data,
                 dv = RT,
                 wid = Participant,
                 within = .(Congruency, prev_Congruency, SOA),
                 detailed = TRUE,
                 return_aov = TRUE)
anova_out(aov.rt)

```

## Post-hoc analyses
```{r}
library(broom)
cong_data<-subset(data, Congruency == 1)
aov.cong = ezANOVA(cong_data,dv = RT,
                  wid = Participant,
                  within = .(prev_Congruency),
                  detailed = TRUE,
                  return_aov = TRUE)
anova_out(aov.cong)

incong_data<-subset(data, Congruency == 0)
aov.incong = ezANOVA(incong_data,dv = RT,
                   wid = Participant,
                   within = .(prev_Congruency),
                   detailed = TRUE,
                   return_aov = TRUE)
anova_out(aov.incong)

k_data<-subset(data, SOA == -100 | SOA == -50)
aov.k = ezANOVA(k_data,dv = RT,
                   wid = Participant,
                   within = .(prev_Congruency, Congruency),
                   detailed = TRUE,
                   return_aov = TRUE)
anova_out(aov.k)
```


## Mean error rates for experimental conditions
```{r}
rm(list = ls())
data = read_excel("spatialStroopSOA.xlsx")

```


## calculate variables

```{r}
gdata <- data.frame(Congruency=fdata$Congruency,

```
